set.n: French Lake's buried money, sec 7 Spring Grove Twp (1839)
set.pl: F. Lake residence on the sec 7/8 line, S edge, Spring Grove Twp (T1N R9E), Green Co (1873 atlas); the 1884 history's 'section 7'
set.st: The 1884 Green County history, in the Town of Spring Grove chapter, says an early settler named French Lake buried his money on section 7 in 1839. Nothing more is told. The 1873 atlas still shows his residence by the creek at the south edge of secs 7/8. Pin is the residence mark, not the spot.
set.t: A one-line county-history note; the 1873 residence mark by the creek is the place to start. Private farmland.
pinev: 1884 Green Co history p. 1050, Town of Spring Grove chapter: an early settler named French Lake buried his money on sec 7 in 1839. 1873 atlas, Spring Grove: 'F. Lake 400' W/NW sec 8, 'Res. F. Lake' at the S edge of secs 7/8 by the creek, 'F. Lake 83.74' N sec 5. Jefferson Twp sec 7 (T1N R8E) has no Lake; the earlier Jefferson reading came from the chapter's Juda heading.
Sec 7 T1N R9E from BLM PLSS (box 42.5595-42.5745 / -89.4846 to -89.4650); pin near the SE corner on the 7/8 line; r300.
